englishTranslation: Thick noodle soup with pork knuckle
atAGlance: Bánh canh giò heo is thick noodle soup with pork knuckle, scallions, pepper, and a rich pork broth. It is heavier and more collagen-rich than the seafood versions.
whatItIs: Bánh canh giò heo is thick noodle soup with pork knuckle, pork broth, scallions, and pepper. It is rich, chewy, and more rustic than a light chicken soup.
howToEnjoy: Expect bones, skin, and tender pork. Ask for leaner pieces if you want less collagen and easier eating.
howLocalsOrder: Bánh canh giò heo is the pork-knuckle version, heavier and more collagen-rich than seafood bowls. Ask for leaner pieces or less pepper if you want the thick noodles without too much richness.
worthKnowing: Giò heo means pork knuckle, a texture Vietnamese diners often enjoy for richness and collagen; this bowl is about chew as much as broth.
goodToKnow: Giò heo means pork knuckle. Expect bones and skin; ask for an easier cut if that is not what you want.
travelerCaution: Contains pork knuckle with bones and skin.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bánh canh giò heo.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bowl of thick noodle soup with pork knuckle.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht toh bahn kan yaw heh-oh
